title: T26 · Cap. 1 · O funil de vendas (narração 41,8 s, ESTIMADA; marcas L1..L5 = início de cada linha do roteiro; FAKE_NOW 2026-11-10T08:30:00-03:00)

setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel|Algo deu errado|Falha ao|Something went wrong/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["CRM/Kanban", "Gerencie oportunidades e acompanhe seu processo comercial.", "Funil de vendas", "Novo", "Em contato", "Proposta", "Ganho", "Perdido"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("main")];const el=els[els.length-1];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,260);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const c=[...document.querySelectorAll('main div.overflow-x-auto')].find(e=>e.querySelector('section header h2'));if(!c)return 'SEM ALVO';const x0=c.scrollLeft,dx=2000-x0,t0=performance.now();if(Math.abs(dx)<3)return 'ok';await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/600),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollLeft=x0+dx*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(c.scrollLeft)})()
